# tinyzoo

> tinyzoo is a code-first CMS for Nuxt 4: the content model is written in `cms.config.ts` (TypeScript), and the database schema, migrations, admin, content API and a typed client are generated from it. A site is one Nuxt app on Node and Postgres; editors work at `/admin`.

Key facts for working in a tinyzoo site: the schema is code-first (never edited in the admin or by hand in the database); after changing `cms.config.ts` run `tinyzoo generate`, review the migration, `tinyzoo up`, and regenerate the client; after updating tinyzoo run `tinyzoo upgrade`. Never use `drizzle-kit push`, never edit generated files, never import exports tagged `@internal`. Every new site has an `AGENTS.md` with these rules.

The same documentation, rendered from the Markdown linked below, is on the website: https://tinyzoo.pushbase.app/en/docs (developer guides in English; the editors' guide in Czech at /dokumentace, English at /en/docs/editors and German at /de/dokumentation/redaktion).

## Building a site

- [AGENTS.md of the starter](https://github.com/tinyzookeeper/tinyzoo/blob/main/packages/cms/starter/AGENTS.md): the short guide every new site gets: where things are, the commands, the change workflow, the don'ts
- [Getting started](https://github.com/tinyzookeeper/tinyzoo/blob/main/docs/guide/getting-started.md): `pnpm create tinyzoo` and its flags, the database, a first collection shown with the typed client
- [Content model](https://github.com/tinyzookeeper/tinyzoo/blob/main/docs/guide/content-model.md): the reference for `cms.config.ts`: every field type and modifier, relations, blocks, globals, presets, languages, publishing (also per language), access rules
- [Roles and permissions](https://github.com/tinyzookeeper/tinyzoo/blob/main/docs/guide/roles.md): `defineRoles`, per-field `.access()`, the media library per role, a removed role, a worked translator example
- [Recipes](https://github.com/tinyzookeeper/tinyzoo/blob/main/docs/guide/recipes.md): complete configs and pages for common client requests (contact form, news, team, FAQ, opening hours, gallery, downloads, events, menus)
- [The content API](https://github.com/tinyzookeeper/tinyzoo/blob/main/docs/guide/content-api.md): endpoints, preview, caching, search, the typed client, OpenAPI, sitemap, the frontend components
- [The content API reference](https://github.com/tinyzookeeper/tinyzoo/blob/main/docs/guide/content-api-reference.md): every route to look things up on: parameters, filters and date ranges, languages and `paths`, drafts and preview, the token, caching headers, errors
- [Media](https://github.com/tinyzookeeper/tinyzoo/blob/main/docs/guide/media.md): uploads, storage drivers, drawing pictures
- [The admin](https://github.com/tinyzookeeper/tinyzoo/blob/main/docs/guide/admin.md): branding, form layouts, custom field renderers
- [Seeding](https://github.com/tinyzookeeper/tinyzoo/blob/main/docs/guide/seeding.md): starting content in code, `tinyzoo seed`

## Stability and upgrades

- [tinyzoo 1.0](https://github.com/tinyzookeeper/tinyzoo/blob/main/docs/stability.md): what the 1.0 stability promise covers and what it does not, what a minor may add, and the Nuxt, Node, Postgres and drizzle versions 1.x stays on
- [The public API](https://github.com/tinyzookeeper/tinyzoo/blob/main/docs/api-surface.md): what 1.0 freezes (config API, `cms` options and variables, content API and client, webhook and hooks, CLI with every flag, frontend kit, admin extension points, the media addresses, external sign-in); the names tinyzoo keeps; which numbers are promised and which are tuning; everything else is internal
- [Upgrading](https://github.com/tinyzookeeper/tinyzoo/blob/main/docs/upgrading.md): the version policy, the steps per release, recipes for renaming, removing and changing fields, the migration guard
- [Deploying](https://github.com/tinyzookeeper/tinyzoo/blob/main/docs/deploying.md): environment variables, migrations at start, backups and restore

## Optional

- [Plugins](https://github.com/tinyzookeeper/tinyzoo/blob/main/docs/plugins.md): collections, admin pages, routes and upgrade steps of your own, shipped as a package
- [The plugin API reference](https://github.com/tinyzookeeper/tinyzoo/blob/main/docs/plugin-reference.md): every option and hook of `defineCmsPlugin`, with its type
- [Analytics](https://github.com/tinyzookeeper/tinyzoo/blob/main/docs/analytics.md): the website's visits in its own admin, without cookies (`tinyzoo/analytics`)
- [Content between environments](https://github.com/tinyzookeeper/tinyzoo/blob/main/docs/guide/content-transfer.md): `tinyzoo export` and `import`
- [Editors' guide](https://github.com/tinyzookeeper/tinyzoo/blob/main/docs/editors/en/README.md): the manual for the people who write content, with the admin's own labels, in [Czech](https://github.com/tinyzookeeper/tinyzoo/blob/main/docs/editors/cs/README.md), English and [German](https://github.com/tinyzookeeper/tinyzoo/blob/main/docs/editors/de/README.md)
